links.comparator_used: Patient-independent deep learning model without calibration (not fine-tuned on any data from the new patient)
links.outcome: Seizure forecast accuracy in independent patients
links.effect: Forecast accuracy of deep learning methods increased on average by more than 20%, and performance improved systematically in all independent patients
links.tradeoff: Calibration requires at least one epileptic event recorded from each new patient.
links.quote: We evaluate our calibration procedure using two datasets containing EEG signals recorded from a large cohort of epileptic subjects, demonstrating that the forecast accuracy of deep learning methods can increase on average by more than 20%, and that performance improves systematically in all independent patients.
